title: When was the Eiffel Tower finished?
subtitle: Guess the year the Eiffel Tower was finished, then hear how a tower built to last twenty years, and hated by artists, was saved by radio.
notes: Year scale 1850–1950 with drawn 1909/1930 marks; tower stands on 1889. Scale tick numbers stay small (fixed 18) even with text.font_size 36.
